summary: Horde hybrid: totem utility, Earth Shock and Lightning Bolt burst, and weapon imbues for melee. Note Ghost Wolf and Frost Shock unlock at level 20, so a 19 shaman leans on totems for map control. Value swings on composition.
factionNotes: Shamans are Horde-only in Classic Era (Orc, Tauren, Troll). Orc Hardiness (reduced stun duration), Tauren Endurance (+5% health), and Troll Berserking (haste) shape flag fights. Verify current racial, totem, and weapon-imbue specifics against the Wowhead Shaman guide at authoring.
